content.value_statement: Authentication code often needs separate client and server patterns. This guide shows Better Auth sign-in, sign-out, and session-checking examples.
actual_capabilities: Explains where to import Better Auth client and server objects.
Shows social sign-in with a Google provider and callback URL.
Shows how to sign out with authClient.signOut.
Shows server-side session checks with auth.api.getSession.
Notes the AuthBar component location and session endpoint.
limitations: Does not install or configure Better Auth.
Does not define database adapters, providers, or environment variables.
Does not implement authorization roles or permissions.
Examples assume existing lib/auth-client.ts and lib/auth.ts files.

use_cases.title: Add a client sign-in flow
use_cases.description: Use the email and social sign-in examples in a Client Component.

use_cases.title: Protect a server endpoint
use_cases.description: Check the Better Auth session before serving a route or Server Action.

use_cases.title: Maintain an authentication UI
use_cases.description: Find the AuthBar component and its session endpoint relationship.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the authentication setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how this project separates Better Auth client and server usage.

prompt_templates.title: Add email sign-in
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Client Component handler that signs in with authClient.signIn.email and reports errors.

prompt_templates.title: Protect a route
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a server-side Better Auth session check to this route. Return 401 when no session exists.

prompt_templates.title: Review an auth integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Better Auth integration for client-server boundaries, session checks, and missing authorization controls.

output_examples.input: How do I protect a Server Action?
output: Import the server auth object and request headers.
Call auth.api.getSession with the current headers.
Return an unauthorized response when the session is absent.

output_examples.input: How do I add Google sign-in?
output: Call authClient.signIn.social from a Client Component.
Set a callback URL for the post-login destination.

best_practices: Keep client sign-in calls inside Client Components.
Validate a session on the server before returning protected data.
Add authorization checks after authentication when resources require roles or ownership.
anti_patterns: Do not trust client-side session state to protect server data.
Do not treat an authenticated session as authorization for every resource.
Do not expose protected actions without a server-side session check.

faq.question: Which authentication library does this guide use?
Where is the client authentication object?
faq.answer: The guide expects authClient in lib/auth-client.ts.

faq.question: Where is the server authentication object?
faq.answer: The guide expects auth in lib/auth.ts.

faq.question: Can this guide sign users in with email?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows authClient.signIn.email with an email and password.

faq.question: Can this guide protect server routes?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows a session check with auth.api.getSession.

faq.question: Does this guide configure Better Auth?
faq.answer: No. It documents usage patterns and assumes Better Auth is already configured.
